newsitem.title: USA: Project Software stock tumbles on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Project Software stock tumbles on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Project Software & Development Inc. lost half its value Wednesday, a day after the software company warned of disappointing earnings for the second quarter.
The stock fell $15.50 to $15.75 on Nasdaq, where it was the day's biggest loser and one of the most active issues.
PSDI, based in Cambridge, Mass., makes software used to maintain high-value capital assets such as plants, facilities and production equipment.

The company said late Tuesday that based on preliminary estimates, it expects to earn 15 cents a share for the second quarter ended March 31, down from 24 cents a share in the year-ago period. This is despite an estimated rise in revenues to $22 million from $16 million, it said.
Final results for the quarter will be reported on April 17, PSDI said after the close of the stock market.
The company attributed the poorer-than-expected results in the historically difficult second quarter to a continued shortfall in certain product revenues as well as softness in Europe.
